Type: shelf
Name: AmazonBasics Sporting Goods Storage Organizer Shelf - Black
Materials: Metal
Two-tiered organizer designed for storing a wide variety of sporting goods Durable metal frame with powder-coated black finish Metal wire basket on top for storing balls and other items Grid hanging system on back and sides with included hooks Easily store items such as skates, shoes, bats, mitts, raquets, and more
